title: Lifting a prescribed finite-free derived model across a nilpotent quotient
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $I\subset R$ an ideal with $I^N=0$ for some $N\geq1$, assume every element of $1+I$ is a unit, and let $K\in D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] be pseudo-coherent [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex]. Let $F^\bullet$ be a bounded-above complex of finite free $R/I$-modules, and let $\alpha:K\otimes_R^L R/I\xrightarrow{\sim}Q(F^\bullet)$ be a specified isomorphism, where $Q$ denotes passage from complexes to the derived category and derived scalar extension is as in [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] on the one-object site with only the identity covering. There exist a bounded-above complex $P^\bullet$ of finite free $R$-modules, an isomorphism $\beta:Q(P^\bullet)\xrightarrow{\sim}K$ in $D(R)$, and an isomorphism of complexes $\theta:P^\bullet\otimes_R R/I\xrightarrow{\sim}F^\bullet$ such that $Q(\theta)=\alpha\circ(\beta\otimes_R^L R/I)$ under the canonical identification $Q(P^\bullet)\otimes_R^L R/I\cong Q(P^\bullet\otimes_R R/I)$. If $F^i=0$ for $i>b$, $P^i$ can be chosen zero for $i>b$.
